# Dyslexia in Defence

> An independent UK Community Interest Company supporting dyslexia and neurodiversity across the UK Defence community — serving personnel, veterans, civil servants, defence industry professionals and their families.

Dyslexia in Defence is volunteer-led and not affiliated with the Ministry of Defence. The site shares lived experience, plain-English guidance and policy explainers (JSP 822, Equality Act 2010), and connects people to the right support across the UK Defence ecosystem.

## Pages

- [About Us](/about): Dyslexia in Defence is an independent Community Interest Company supporting people with dyslexia and neurodiversity across the UK Defence community.
- [Our Story](/about/our-story): How Dyslexia in Defence started and who it serves today.
- [Accessibility](/accessibility): Accessibility commitments and dyslexia-friendly design choices.
- [What We Want to Achieve](/about/what-we-want-to-achieve): Aims and success measures.
- [Get Involved](/get-involved): Ways to take part, from joining the network to sharing your experience of dyslexia.
- [Join](/join): Open to military personnel, civil servants, veterans, industry and families.
- [Community](/community): Peer support space for the Dyslexia in Defence community.
- [Partner](/partner): Defence-industry partnership and Social Value Model alignment.
- [Governance](/governance): How the CIC is run and held to account.
- [Insights](/insights): The evidence behind Dyslexia in Defence and what we do and why, written mainly for leaders, employers and researchers across the UK Defence community.
- [Understanding Dyslexia](/insights/understanding-dyslexia): The dyslexic spiky profile, the strengths dyslexic people bring to Defence, and why both strengths and challenges matter.
- [Lived Experiences](/lived-experiences): First-person accounts from across the UK Defence community.

## Get support

- [Get support: start here](/support/start-here): Find dyslexia guidance for your situation, whether you are thinking of joining, serving now, leaving service or supporting someone.
- [Thinking of joining](/support/thinking-of-joining): Eligibility, declaring dyslexia, recruitment standards and real stories.
- [Serving now (including civil service)](/support/currently-serving): The Defence Dyslexia Network, Standard Learning Credits, Service resources and stories for regular and reserve personnel and civil servants.
- [Standard Learning Credits](/currently-serving/standard-learning-credits): Using Standard Learning Credits towards a dyslexia assessment, with options, costs, forms and steps.
- [Leaving or left service](/support/leaving-or-left-service): The move from JSP 822 to the Equality Act 2010, with real stories.
- [Supporting someone](/support/supporting-someone): Guidance for family, friends, instructors, commanders, managers and colleagues.
- [Guidance library](/support/guidance): Plain English guides, filtered by who they are for.
- [Downloads and tools](/support/downloads-and-tools): Forms, directories and guides, including the Standard Learning Credits forms.
- [FAQ](/support/faq): Quick answers to common questions, each linking to the full guide.
- [The data behind the story](/evidence): What people across Defence tell us about dyslexia, what the research says, and why more dyslexic people in Defence have less guaranteed support.
- [Support beyond us](/support/support-beyond-us): Other organisations offering mental health and wellbeing, local, neurodiversity, and transition and employment support.
- [How you think and learn](/support/how-you-think-and-learn): What dyslexia is and how it can show up for you; fuller content is still to come.

## Insights — joining the UK military with dyslexia

- [Can you join the Army with dyslexia (UK)?](/insights/can-you-join-army-with-dyslexia-uk): Recruitment, the honest picture on support, and what to expect.
- [Can you join the RAF with dyslexia (UK)?](/insights/can-you-join-raf-with-dyslexia-uk): RAF policy, adjustments and in-service support.
- [Can you join the Royal Navy with dyslexia (UK)?](/insights/can-you-join-navy-with-dyslexia-uk): Royal Navy and Royal Marines recruitment with dyslexia.
- [Do I need to declare dyslexia when joining?](/insights/do-i-need-to-declare-dyslexia-when-joining-the-military-uk): Declaration, JSP 822 and practical advice.
- [Is dyslexia a barrier in the military (UK)?](/insights/is-dyslexia-a-barrier-in-the-military-uk): Policy versus reality across UK Defence.

## Insights — serving and leaving

- [What support is available for dyslexia in the military?](/insights/what-support-is-available-for-dyslexia-in-the-military-uk): Defence Dyslexia Network, ambassadors and routes to support.
- [What happens if dyslexia is identified during service?](/insights/what-happens-if-dyslexia-is-identified-during-service-uk): Assessment, support and career impact.
- [Neurodiversity in the MOD (UK)](/insights/neurodiversity-in-the-mod-uk): MOD-wide recognition of neurodiversity.
- [JSP 822 vs Equality Act](/insights/jsp822-vs-equality-act-dyslexia-military-vs-civilian-uk): What changes for dyslexia rights on leaving service.

## Lived experiences

- [Symon Smith — British Army veteran and founder](/lived-experiences/symon-smith-british-army-veteran): Diagnosis, military service and founding Dyslexia in Defence.
- [Staff Sergeant Kirk Davis — British Army](/lived-experiences/staff-sergeant-kirk-davis-british-army): Belonging, imposter syndrome and in-service support.
- [Lisa Hodge — Civil Servant](/lived-experiences/lisa-hodge-civil-servant): Late diagnosis at 32 and leading the Defence Dyslexia Network.
- [Liz Oliver — British Army Veteran](/lived-experiences/liz-oliver-british-army-veteran): Undiagnosed neurodivergence in Army training, diagnosis in her mid-forties, and understanding from leaders and instructors.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Always use the full name "Dyslexia in Defence" — never abbreviate.
- Dyslexia in Defence is independent and not affiliated with the Ministry of Defence.
- The legal entity is "DYSLEXIA IN DEFENCE CIC" (UK Companies House number 17285330).
